title: Why The Richest Americans Outlive The Poorest By Over A Decade
hook: Your paycheck decides how long you get to live, and the gap keeps growing.
closing: Money doesn't just buy comfort. It buys years, and that gap keeps growing.
question: Would you want to know your number?

segments.say: The richest American men outlive the poorest men by 14.6 years, more than a decade of life lost to a paycheck.
Sixty years of medical progress added only about 9 years to the average American life -- less than that richest-poorest gap alone.
Since 2001, the richest fifth of Americans gained 2.3 years of life while the poorest fifth barely gained any.
